changelog.body:
## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`f8b9895`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/f8b989554dc5dce6b9eb026b0724c4a96004465e) *(scope)* Fix apps remaining locked after removal due to unkeyed package entries by @official-Arvind in [#61](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/61)

- [`223c6a5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/223c6a5c82b115ef794f6c77c1e64345632f0a09) *(ui)* Keep the personal copy locked when unlocking a work profile app by @hxreborn

    Turning off a work profile app no longer also unlocks the personal copy of the same app.


### CI/CD

- [`b2ca111`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b2ca111a8b1b93627137f0845d885b9d1528eeba) *(deps)* Bump the compose group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in [#57](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/57)

    Bumps the compose group with 2 updates in the / directory: androidx.compose:compose-bom and androidx.compose.material3:material3.

- [`3b179cd`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/3b179cded936799fc86d1895b2e1ff5e293e877d) *(deps)* Bump com.android.application in the agp group by @dependabot[bot] in [#62](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/62)

    Bumps the agp group with 1 update: com.android.application.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`cb385e4`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/cb385e456eb69acb323f0d6cea21e3476fe4c326) Add native OEM face unlock for Samsung and Xiaomi by @official-Arvind in [#50](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/50)

    Locked apps can now be unlocked with the built-in face scanner on Samsung and Xiaomi devices, where the standard prompt does not offer it.


### Refactor

- [`0102b4e`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/0102b4e7b9c3c7e74d733961daabc66c82691970) Drop the unused context parameter from usableAuthenticators by @hxreborn

- [`62b76d3`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/62b76d325606dfcee94ca7e7a83ebd560117ebd2) Scope the Samsung sensor-class match to Samsung devices by @hxreborn

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`5bcfefe`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/5bcfefea4aafc1291ec9a64b2f8c461850517123) *(hook)* Re-issue a blocked screen pin once the app is unlocked by @hxreborn

    Pinning a locked app from recents now pins it after the unlock prompt is passed, instead of opening the app unpinned.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`9fcaded`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/9fcaded6bc9e4569baec4f983a9c2cae5bce2f98) *(hook)* Skip the uninstall prompt for versioned library packages by @hxreborn

    Chrome and WebView updates no longer raise the biometric prompt while removing the old copy of their shared library.

- [`c498ef5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/c498ef5cc5822872429062de56decb6313b7f7de) *(ui)* Find hook logs when the Xposed framework is not LSPosed by @hxreborn

    Shared logs now include the hook log on Xposed forks that keep it outside LSPosed's own folder.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`3b6c34b`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/3b6c34ba29083f27d858645316f2e9d48eb8ab98) *(hook)* Keep an app unlocked when an overlay opens over it by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer ask for authentication again after a share sheet, permission dialog or similar overlay appears on top of them.

- [`c98b00d`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/c98b00dd2ec2b532ec414449f4a2b037fbeda779) *(hook)* Return work profile apps to their profile after auth by @official-Arvind in [#58](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/58)

    Locked work profile apps no longer open as the personal copy after the resume prompt, and the MIUI face prompt now releases the front camera when it closes.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`fa878c5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/fa878c50d8e43222f226b142d688f3f7ee304f0a) *(auth)* Fall back to device credential when biometrics lock out by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer become unopenable after too many failed fingerprint or face attempts.

- [`b5653df`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b5653dfdb6b6e624cf4f5ee7138774554930c900) *(auth)* Use the solid prompt when a locked app is already on screen by @hxreborn

    A locked app coming back from the recents screen is covered as soon as the prompt starts instead of staying readable behind it.

- [`1f9f29a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/1f9f29aabf594f9ca4e3dabd82cbefb544f8d417) *(hook)* Show the unlock prompt for locked apps in a work profile by @hxreborn

    Locked work profile apps no longer bounce straight back to the home screen when tapped.

- [`82db0c3`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/82db0c31c458b46eab03546a5a91dee96bd1829b) *(hook)* Lock apps reopened from the recents screen without a launch by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer open without authentication when you return to them from the recents screen.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`1d01adc`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/1d01adcd24923303090c04986246a4e7c2fff6ec) *(hook)* Relock an app left right after it was unlocked by @hxreborn

    Locked apps now ask for authentication again when reopened after briefly going to the home screen.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`b6946e5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b6946e528d4365cc9662543d92248d0e17e33cfe) *(hook)* Keep an app unlocked while it comes to the foreground by @hxreborn

    The unlock prompt no longer reappears several times in a row before a locked app opens.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`160c7be`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/160c7be859a72c0e9bd8de3b2cd3a5bb858981d3) *(ui)* Add 3 and 10 minute re-lock delays plus a custom value by @hxreborn

    Custom delays are entered in minutes and apply to the global delay and to
  per-app overrides.


### Bug Fixes

- [`2a52819`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/2a52819ee628ed8ca09ebcfa6d69f4198656f785) *(hook)* Drop the second prompt when uninstalling from the system dialog by @hxreborn

    Uninstalling an app through the system dialog now asks for biometrics once instead of twice.

- [`15e3ff2`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/15e3ff2271ecc9733dec5b19e477c72fd23407dd) *(hook)* Resume install prompts as the app that requested them by @hxreborn

    Installing an app now goes through on the first tap instead of needing a second one after the prompt.

- [`06a0428`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/06a0428129da15875d4f8e88740e7450ed801d05) *(hook)* Stop re-prompting when an installer asks for pre-approval by @hxreborn

    Installing an app from a store that asks for confirmation up front no longer repeats the biometric prompt forever.

- [`63c588d`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/63c588d87a9ce07bbbaa76db3c980a990ed7c944) *(hook)* Block screen pinning from opening a locked app without auth by @hxreborn

    Pinning a locked app from recents no longer opens it without authentication.

- [`adad21f`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/adad21fb120cb4a7d5054132c2301e08a206e69c) *(hook)* Relock a locked app when the user goes home by @hxreborn

    Locked apps set to re-lock immediately now ask for the prompt again after
  you leave them for the home screen, not only after another app opens.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`4186630`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/418663088a6a54147fe15ba12a909f9fe7e901ef) *(hook)* Send a locked app home when the unlock prompt cannot start by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer open without authentication in the seconds after a reboot, when the prompt cannot be shown yet.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`5352b09`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/5352b09f21ceb9bd6c15ef77d66ad75e3ae37164) *(hook)* Redact the lockscreen copy of a locked app notification by @hxreborn

    Notifications from a locked app no longer reveal their content on the lockscreen when Android is set to hide sensitive content.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`84a80c7`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/84a80c7416dd4298b20d9d4e43fdedb60f1e7699) *(hook)* Hide notification content while an app is locked by @hxreborn

    Notifications posted by a locked app now show a placeholder instead of their title and text until the app is unlocked.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`8d6a251`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/8d6a25111162a4b21153b61572b35d3239698201) *(auth)* Resume apps with no startable activity after unlock by @hxreborn

    Unlocking an app that has no launchable entry now opens it instead of returning to the home screen.

- [`00ec23c`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/00ec23c3a605a6e47275717eb9b7ebcfb1ad91ee) *(ui)* Show apps without a launcher activity in the app list by @hxreborn

    Iconless packages like Shell now appear in the app list and stay visible on the dashboard while locked.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`cd42461`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/cd4246193b9ed703937e78e513b690855b0753d4) Add a per-app mode that locks only the selected activities by @hxreborn

    An app's activity list can now be flipped so only the checked activities ask for the unlock prompt.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`36ccdf2`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/36ccdf2e01755081d385c2247d4f46f468bced66) *(auth)* Start the unlock prompt on first window focus by @hxreborn

    The unlock prompt no longer cancels itself the moment a locked app launches, which sent you home before you could authenticate.

- [`12554f5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/12554f5ce72eccac1e2e646c57712db54088a033) *(hook)* Skip redirect when a recents launch already has a posted auth by @hxreborn

    Reopening a locked app from recents no longer stacks a second unlock prompt behind the one already on screen.

- [`35e40ed`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/35e40ed80262c3cf571c470264bf4076da6207fd) *(hook)* Validate token package before consuming a pending unlock by @hxreborn

    Unlocking an app from recents no longer asks for a second authentication right after the first one succeeds.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`0764416`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/0764416db615efec5d135ad5bc79abd50639b52e) *(auth)* Choose which biometrics and screen lock unlock apps by @hxreborn

    The unlock prompt and the app's own settings lock now offer face unlock where it counts as a weak-class biometric, with an option to require the strongest biometrics or the screen lock instead.

- [`b6c630c`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b6c630cb9a15a033f7c1a90296dee584761fc059) *(ui)* Set unlock methods for a single app by @hxreborn

    An app can now use its own biometric and screen lock choice instead of the global one.

- [`1e3496c`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/1e3496ca07182a839161b19eb00865331132cb11) *(ui)* Label each sensor's biometric class on the dashboard by @hxreborn

    The hardware card now shows whether the fingerprint reader and face unlock are Class 3 or Class 2 on this device instead of one combined label.


### Bug Fixes

- [`b0b6c3f`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b0b6c3f88da3f34f820530582799255b2006e1ca) *(auth)* Retry the unlock prompt when it self-cancels on launch by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer bounce back to the home screen when the unlock prompt disappears before you can authenticate.

- [`af8af65`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/af8af65983fba46313e2a7ab36e101b4b365ad1c) *(prefs)* Apply setting changes without a reboot on all Xposed builds by @hxreborn

    Changes to the locked app list and other settings now take effect immediately on Xposed builds where they previously applied only after a reboot.


### Refactor

- [`87a708f`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/87a708f4e1e535526c4c1daaa47a427fd2776257) *(ui)* Use primary elevated card for active status by @hxreborn

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`462ed1a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/462ed1a10980f41ae968d2adb263b85897db2cdc) *(auth)* Add screen lock fallback to self-lock by @hxreborn

    Adds a setting to let the screen lock open the app's own settings when biometrics fail.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`1c3e18e`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/1c3e18ed4c2e3302b42e279733c284f105c7172f) *(hook)* Mark reflected methods accessible by @hxreborn

    Locked apps no longer open without authentication on devices where the unlock prompt failed to appear.

- [`623a8ab`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/623a8ab0efabdbeb36b2710a4cf410a60218c0d1) *(ui)* Rebuild nav bar without removed override API by @hxreborn

- [`7b20f9a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/7b20f9ab6f2e388ee162da512c4a1077bf887646) *(ui)* Use surface colors in floating navbar by @hxreborn

    The floating navigation bar now matches the surface colors used elsewhere in the app.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`56743dc`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/56743dc59eefb037038014021045f817cd0ab86f) *(auth)* Add screen lock fallback toggle by @hxreborn

    Adds a toggle to unlock apps with the screen lock (PIN, pattern, or password) when biometrics fail, on by default.


### Bug Fixes

- [`4184a15`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/4184a1586062f14a80dabe2fc6ce46ad8b423a4e) *(ui)* Reflect manual hot reload in dashboard by @hxreborn

    Show the system hook reload time after a hot reload if triggered manually from the debug build.

- [`63a7e88`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/63a7e8879fb6e3c7e624fb938239e3252a98fe54) *(ui)* Cap app icon bitmap size by @hxreborn

    The app list no longer crashes while scrolling on certain ROMs.


### Refactor

- [`fc1dd96`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/fc1dd9685fbe28cdcb07868873c7301d3c498fb6) *(ui)* Trim hot reload status text by @hxreborn

- [`b952d3e`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b952d3e4c3b82a49936a00ed9a438e11ee28e2e0) *(ui)* Clarify app management coverage text by @hxreborn

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`d50a601`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/d50a60161da21b6369d2cd604f8a209e74082f7f) *(ui)* Dedupe app list by package and user by @hxreborn

    Apps that show more than one launcher icon no longer crash the apps screen.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`4d926c5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/4d926c517dec5977b2be2cf1798fa85f165e07d0) *(hook)* Find framework members by declaration by @hxreborn

    Improves framework compatibility so locked apps and screenshot blocking work on more devices.

- [`7818db4`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/7818db470c3dba6e3a03b84301e731468339379c) Include app crashes in diagnostic logs by @hxreborn

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`68c5d4a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/68c5d4a1d2b57c11e1f1428f6003d550f04fe664) Hot reload the module on update by @hxreborn

    App updates apply with no reboot, if your framework supports it.


### Bug Fixes

- [`95525e5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/95525e5a416b4ec7d9570ec7e27e431c451ca006) *(ui)* Preserve list scroll on sub-screen nav by @hxreborn

    Slide the nav bar with a graphicsLayer instead of removing it from layout, so the Scaffold bottom inset stays constant.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`52c3527`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/52c3527e1b0d6ca6a86ddc1c9c855f118c7bf7c6) *(hook)* Resolve task package without optional framework methods by @hxreborn

    Swiping a locked app from recents re-locks it on Samsung OneUI.

- [`5a19246`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/5a19246538aedada1a31cbf54793f52036d6ca87) *(module)* Normalize legacy locked-package keys by @hxreborn

    Apps locked before 1.5 stay locked after a version downgrade and reinstall.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`9330637`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/9330637ed4c69296c1136b839128156cefc248dc) *(hook)* Warn when task lookup init fails by @hxreborn

- [`bef6282`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/bef628234975e9535815bc22a652d19779ee9d61) *(hook)* Relock swiped tasks without cache entry by @hxreborn

    Swiping a locked app from recents now re-locks it on OneUI.

## What's Changed



### Bug Fixes

- [`2ad25f4`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/2ad25f4bd5c9a86d00e25ac74d7de4c79ccb0e78) *(hook)* Stop recents tap relocking resumed app by @hxreborn

    Recents no longer relocks the app being resumed and locked apps now prompt from recents on OneUI.

- [`88ddce0`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/88ddce0d09bf4d15a39f605664d98c837f86b6ce) *(hook)* Skip uri regrant on stripped ROMs by @hxreborn

    Avoids failing on ROMs where the URI grant methods are absent.


### Refactor

- [`e14b53e`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/e14b53e41982bf59dc5ba301e48e1e8943d3916b) *(hook)* Extract launch and relock helpers by @hxreborn

    Adds small helpers for maintainability with no behavior change.

## What's Changed

### Features

- [`dc3ad67`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/dc3ad67d8553a3e8e2858af5e26edf409aa30e39) Require biometric to install or remove apps by @hxreborn

- [`7542e48`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/7542e483dbefc79acf5c310538a1b81cdfb5b09d) Add work profile support by @klab7 in [#15](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/pull/15)

### Bug Fixes

- [`8389496`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/8389496164d8f421697ba9d72b8c4d52d2a3f45b) *(hook)* Regrant content uris on auth replay by @hxreborn

- [`81878a9`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/81878a93f216bc7d5868b96a32ecaa01f15fbe05) *(hook)* Always evict a removed task from the cache by @hxreborn

### Performance Improvements

- [`3af611a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/3af611a381df01516900b607464bbdf67efac63d) *(hook)* Branch prefs listener by key by @hxreborn

- [`19fb1ee`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/19fb1eefa3932501f5fdb81e748c30bb6b27b913) *(ui)* Load SelfLockScreen icon off main via shared cache by @hxreborn

- [`ad368ad`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/ad368ada2fb6c1dce12789692a509c0a6ee63d62) *(ui)* Use MotionScheme effects spec for mechanical fades by @hxreborn

- [`25747ce`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/25747ce4f77c05cda2d76f105843752a09fbbf0b) *(ui)* Add contentType to lazy list items for pool reuse by @hxreborn

### Refactor

- [`f046efc`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/f046efcad013353f355a12ee67d5f54e18055df0) *(hook)* Drop silent fallbacks in module startup by @hxreborn

- [`52c12a4`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/52c12a4ce4c9f0291733d644deb13cf10f3b54f1) *(ui)* Adopt shared BackButton across nav screens by @hxreborn

- [`e8251d1`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/e8251d13a57d51a80b567f781ff509315392e71e) *(ui)* Consolidate biometric class into one row by @hxreborn

- [`865c953`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/865c95315b8bbd5313ee831efbf3dc0ef3adeacd) Wire ViewModel into service listener bus by @hxreborn

- [`0adc6f6`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/0adc6f616b7140fe5b8d574f520dd07cfb87575e) Rename boundService to mService by @hxreborn

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`a0e4291`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/a0e429192229f7e146fd2b65f4e8506a70479ab1) Add activity whitelist by @hxreborn

    Adds an option to whitelist activities from any app.

- [`b8a4573`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/b8a4573e2701ef69ee2cd131e9ee85b876490b4d) Add solid unlock screen by @hxreborn

    Adds an option for a solid unlock screen on phones where the see-through one closes by itself.

## What's Changed



### Features

- [`dd9d4d6`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/dd9d4d6d508b6b569be6a68471c401342fe18410) *(auth)* Unlock locked apps with screen lock by @hxreborn

    A locked app now falls back to the device PIN, pattern, or password when biometrics are unavailable, and can optionally require a confirmation tap after face unlock.

- [`7c02081`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/7c02081ff559be14d639960fe1b2df750e5f4f4b) *(hook)* Relock when a task is removed by @hxreborn

    Swiping a locked app off the recents screen drops its unlock, so the next launch asks for authentication again.

- [`e6af8b5`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/e6af8b5b3829e4c85c3867a7d5f8e59b6c6e801f) *(ui)* Make debug builds obvious at a glance by @hxreborn

    Debug builds now show a marker in the header so they are easy to tell apart.

- [`06e647c`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/06e647c4344ab18b3c1d8c3a7c192c73b1c5419a) *(ui)* Require biometric to open settings by @hxreborn

    The app can now require fingerprint, face, or device credential before it opens, and shows an error or lockout message when authentication fails.

- [`997c6cc`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/997c6cc32bcdf7f2d39e1866bf65d6527405073f) *(ui)* Add confirm before hiding launcher icon by @hxreborn

    Hiding the app icon now asks you to confirm first.

- [`664a692`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/664a69265edb5dfb9ce081f098247615824048eb) *(ui)* Capture more detail in log export by @hxreborn

    The log header now records build type, ROM, and capture time.

- [`fcbaf2a`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/fcbaf2acca7e2223b06f3198c40f806be882a8a5) *(ui)* Save logs to a file by @hxreborn

    Logs can now be saved to the device in addition to sharing.


### Bug Fixes

- [`31e8129`](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/commit/31e81291091509a69dbaa1bb51ed079264a19f23) *(hook)* Reopen locked apps on the right screen by @hxreborn

    Locked apps now reopen on the exact screen that was tapped, including deep links and non-exported notification targets, instead of restarting at the launcher.

readme:
Xposed module that intercepts the launches of a user-defined list of apps at the System Framework level. Those activities are never created until you authenticate via fingerprint or face unlock.

> [!NOTE] > Built for AOSP and Pixel. Other Android flavors may work if not heavily modified, such as One UI 8+, but others are untested. If you're on HyperOS, OxygenOS, ColorOS, etc. your device already includes a built-in app lock and you probably don't need this. ## About this module Stock Android never had a native per-app lock, and [Private Space](https://source.android.com/docs/security/features/private-space) (available since Android 15 Beta 2) is a secondary isolated profile where apps run as separate installs with their own data. This module intercepts activity launches at the system framework level before the target app starts. The Activity is never created until auth succeeds. Tapping a locked app from the recents screen is intercepted too. Enabling the module needs one reboot so it loads at boot. After that, if your framework supports hot reload, app updates apply with no reboot. If not, you still reboot after each update. Changing which apps are locked is always instant. ## Requirements - Android 13+ with an enrolled biometric - Xposed manager with libxposed API 101 or newer (102 enables hot reload) ## Install 1. Install APK from [Releases](../../releases) 2. Enable module in your Xposed manager with System Framework scope 3. Reboot 4. Select apps to lock in the Apps tab ## Prevent uninstall Toggle in Settings → Privacy & stealth. While on, the module blocks every attempt to uninstall itself, including `adb uninstall` and `pm uninstall`, since it's enforced in the system framework. > [!IMPORTANT] > To remove the module with the toggle on: > 1. Turn it off in the app, then uninstall. No reboot needed. > 2. If for some reason you can't open the app to disable the toggle, either disable the module in your Xposed manager and reboot or boot to safe mode where Xposed is off and uninstall. ## Block screenshots Toggle it globally in Settings or per app in its detail screen. Changes apply immediately, no reboot or hot reload. While on, an unlocked locked app's screenshots, screen recording, and recents preview are blocked. The per-app setting overrides the global one, so an app can stay blocked with the global toggle off. It cannot beat modules that force FLAG_SECURE off, like Disable Flag Secure by aviraxp. After you turn the block off, that app's recents card can stay blank since the system cached it while the block was on. Swipe it off recents and reopen the app for a fresh preview. ## Reporting issues Settings → About → Export logs saves the module's log lines to a text file and opens a share sheet, so you can attach them to a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/issues/new), send them by [email](mailto:hxreborn@duck.com), or share via [Telegram](https://t.me/hxreb0rn). Reproduce the issue first, then export. Reading the LSPosed logs needs root. Only this module's own log lines are exported, so they're safe to attach to a public issue. Debug builds help me most. ## License [![GPL-3.0-only](https://img.shields.io/badge/LICENSE-GPL--3.0--only-%23A42E2B?style=for-the-badge&logo=gnu&logoColor=white&logoPosition=right)](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-app-lock/blob/main/LICENSE)
